notes: Godot 4 playable 3D mirrored-island puzzle (18 levels) by Tommaso Brighina. SPDX MIT. Third-party packs are all CC0 1.0 (KayKit Platformer, KayKit Block Bits, Kenney Platformer Kit, Kenney Cube Pets, Kenney Input Prompts, Kenney Game Icons, Quaternius Ultimate Platformer Pack clouds), credited in upstream README. Includes MIT godot_super-wakatime editor plugin under src/addons/godot_super-wakatime/. No bundled fonts or audio. Replaced the upstream default Godot icon.svg with an original twin-island mark (md5 2f4c650cef86f97abcde1de9d035da5b). No Git LFS, no editor .godot, no signing keystore.
